notes.title: Rebuild of EPIC Zombies
notes.notes:
Hey all 

I am completely rebuilding EPIC ZOMBIES from the ground up

To make the game run better and have a lot more content so I will upload early builds for you to try 

Please keep in mind this is a full rebuild so your save will get corrupted as we embark on this journey

I will add many thing and stuff might break and contain bugs but please keep in mind I will fix and update the game to get it to a state where I am happy with it

Much Love

ZeNN Gaming

notes.title: Future of EPIC ZOMBIES
notes.notes:
Hey all

Just to let everyone know I did release the game early for the reason I want to involve the player and gather feedback bad or good and shape the future of EPIC ZOMBIES with the community

The game is in very early access and I am still going to develop the game 

My plans are adding

Driving Cars
More Horses to ride
Fishing
Swimming
Traders
More variety zombies and bandits
More guns
More melee weapons
More items like clothing , backpack , headwear etc
And much more

I will also be working on a new map as I know FPS is low on the current map (So I got feedback to start working on a smaller map and gradually improve and expand on it and its a very good idea)

So please keep the feedback coming (good or bad) coming so that I can improve and build the game where the people wants it

Please keep in mind the game is very early access and updates will get pushed as time goes on 

Much love

ZeNN
